description: The line plot illustrates the variation of ASR across different categories for three conditions under a clean-label scenario with a 10% poison rate in the AGNews dataset. The x-axis is categorical, displaying the labels 'cf', 'bb', 'WNBA', 'ESPN', 'NHL', 'FIFA', 'Estadio', and 'athletics' without an overarching axis label or units. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and features a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 at intervals of 0.1. Three solid lines represent the different conditions, as indicated by a legend in the bottom right. The 'start' condition is represented by a solid green line with small dot markers; it begins at approximately 0.77 at 'cf', drops sharply to a low of 0.49 at 'bb', rises to a local peak of 0.90 at 'WNBA', dips to 0.82 at 'ESPN', and then steadily increases to end at its highest point of 0.93 at 'athletics'. The 'random' condition is shown as a solid orange line with 'x' markers, starting at roughly 0.66 at 'cf', declining to 0.52 at 'bb', increasing to 0.87 at 'WNBA', dropping to 0.72 at 'ESPN', and then rising to a peak of 0.94 at 'Estadio' before ending at 0.87 at 'athletics'. The 'end' condition is depicted by a solid purple line with circular markers, which starts at 0.75 at 'cf', falls to a minimum of 0.57 at 'bb', rises to 0.88 at 'WNBA', drops to 0.74 at 'ESPN', increases to 0.89 at 'NHL', dips to 0.81 at 'FIFA', reaches its maximum peak at 0.97 at 'Estadio', and concludes at 0.83 at 'athletics'.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates how ASR values vary across different categories under a clean-label scenario with a 10% poison rate in the AGNews dataset. The x-axis represents different categories labeled as 'cf', 'bb', 'WNBA', 'ESPN', 'NHL', 'FIFA', 'Estadio', and 'athletics', with categorical spacing and no units. The y-axis, labeled 'ASR', has a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with a tick interval of 0.1. Three lines are depicted: a green line with circular markers and a solid line style labeled 'start', beginning around 0.8 at 'cf', sharply declining to 0.5 at 'bb', then peaking at approximately 0.9 at 'WNBA' and ending at 0.92 at 'athletics'; an orange line with x-shaped markers and a dashed line style labeled 'random', starting near 0.65 at 'cf', sharply declining to 0.5 at 'bb', peaking at approximately 0.88 at 'WNBA', and ending at 0.85 at 'athletics'; a purple line with circular markers and a solid line style labeled 'end', starting around 0.75 at 'cf', showing peaks and troughs, and sharply declining to 0.58 at 'bb', then increasing steadily to end at approximately 0.9 at 'athletics'. The 'end' line consistently exceeds the 'random' line across all categories except 'bb', where both lines converge. A legend is given at the bottom right.
